title: Restore historical checks after the CI documentation update
body:
## Summary

The registered historical-snapshot check fails on current main because the tooling-ledger adapter rejects `docs/ci-verification.md` after merged #3139 appended its deadline instructions. Admit only that exact reviewed successor SHA-256, `a3711fe12d560fac7726c530b9c8c622182f3d4f231a876c163616e49bd911bc`. The old accepted hash remains allowed. Historical replay still authenticates and restores the original `a854022e…` document against the unchanged frontier741 manifest.

The added test uses the real adapter configuration, manifest and frozen document. It proves the temporary overlay contains the original bytes, leaves the current checkout unchanged, and rejects an unknown live append, a corrupted frozen document and a changed nested source pin. It runs through the existing registered package and watched CI test module.

Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. Tekalign's #3139 commit `54bbb81cc884819154776900830eeb4d9db4dc5e` preserves the entire previous 8,297-byte document and appends 28 lines. This closes the document-admission issue explicitly left open by Arham Tahir's #3348 and our #3644; it preserves Dennis's historical adapter and all predecessor attribution. No frozen source, manifest, selected result or document is edited.

## Test plan

Local environment: macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.14, Git 2.54.0.

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/historical-snapshot-one-pass`: before, 27 tests with 1 failure and 1 error at the document guard; after, all 28 tests pass. The new focused test also fails independently against the original adapter.
- [x] `python3.12 -O -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_historical_check.py' -k ci_document_successor -v`: passes, including all three rejection controls.
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/isolated-test-bytecode` and `--package research/isolated-descendant-bytecode`: every registered command passes; their declared outcomes remain `completed` / `partial`.
- [x] Independent read-only review and independent focused regression pass. Frozen-document and coverage-manifest bytes match canonical main; `git diff --check` passes.

The full many-package `tooling-ledger` replay was not run, and hosted CI has not run yet; this claim is limited to the actual registered checks and exact-source overlay above. Fresh overlap review covered 354 open PRs, 2,964 closed PRs and 2,458 discussion records, plus targeted live searches; no equivalent repair was found.

Prepared for roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including independent AI review. Apache-2.0.
